description: The OPARA release contains processed cycling-trip statistics from Germany’s City Cycling smartphone campaign in 2022–2024. The provider page lists three yearly trip CSV files, city-level statistics, documentation and an R processing example under CC BY-NC 4.0 in DataCite rights metadata. Participants recorded GPS tracks during a selected three-week campaign window; the published tables replace raw trajectories with origins, destinations and trip measures. The article and repository abstract report more than eight million trip records, 37 variables and 109 selected municipalities. The title says “100 cities”, while the specifications table and description say 109; the difference is unresolved. Coverage is self-selected campaign users in selected municipalities, not all German cycling or continuous year-round travel. Recruitment, seasonal windows and aggregation limit population or route inference. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is calibrating relative cycling-trip characteristics or comparing city scenarios. model-radsim-cycling-traffic-simulation is a related model, with no verified input mapping to these tables. No CSV, spreadsheet, PDF or code file was downloaded or run.
